tools.input:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
p=Path('/workspace/work/decision.md')
s=p.read_text()
links=re.findall(r'\\]\\((/workspace/["'^)]+)'"\\)',s)
missing=[x for x in links if not Path(x).is_file()]
sources=[Path(x).read_text() for x in dict.fromkeys(links)]
ids=set(re.findall(r'record-[0-9a-f]{10}',s))
known='\\n'.join(sources)+'\\n'+'\\n'.join(links)
uncited_ids=sorted(i for i in ids if i not in known)
assert not missing, missing
assert not uncited_ids, uncited_ids
assert 'Submission date: unknown.' in s
assert 'age_days=20' in s
print(f'Checked {len(links)} local links and {len(ids)} source IDs; all resolve in the cited records or paths.')
print(f'Decision saved: {p} ({len(s.split())} words).')
PY"
